text:
Substations
Technical Procedure
Equipment
 Battery Charger 
 3PF-2-60
Introduction
This document 
outlines the inspection checklist I1, which 
must be carried out on a monthly 
bases as indicated in the above 
title block by M1. The 
first draft has been 
initiated by eng. El-Sayed 
Abdel Moneam El-Geddawy and 
tested at 21 April 2002 for charger no.1 at Sheraton El Matar 66kv Substation, 
Cairo zone.
The Charger technical data:
Input voltage 3*380 v AC, 
Output voltage 220 v DC, Output current 50A DC
Input voltage tolerance + 
15%, Input frequency tolerance + 5%
Safety 
Precautions
Wearing goggles, safety shoes, helmet, and rubber gloves 
 is very important
Switch off the power supply
No smoking permitted
Work order must be issuedand 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Tools and Equipments
Digital voltmeter
Suitable tool 
 set,
 Brush
Vacuum Cleaner or blower
Work to be carried out
By selector transfer the battery to the stand-by charger
Disconnect the power supply
Check ventilation system
Clean the charger from dust and dirties (be careful when 
 using the brush to avoid dismantling any connections of wires)
Check fuses, contacts and terminals
Check the overheating compartments of control board
Switch on input and output supply
Check output voltages, the standard values is:
